recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as the reconciliation for FHIR-14796. Do not reopen the 2018 core issue; if OO wants to prohibit future prose uses of lab in current Observation or DiagnosticReport text, create a separate scoped editorial tracker.

The commit is an ancestor of the current source.

Community searches found no conflicting substantive discussion; related sibling issues and a later US Core issue were encountered but not decided because they are separate issues or specifications.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The Jira-quoted Observation sentence and the original application-trail phrases already use laboratory in current source. Remaining current lab strings are example codes/displays, URLs or filenames, mapping-pattern comparison text, example labels, or later unrelated prose that would need a separate current editorial decision for any global cleanup.
